stories.title: Firefighters rescue four dogs from house fire in northwest Knoxville
stories.summary: The Knoxville Fire Department said no people were home at the time of the fire, but four dogs were found safe.

stories.title: East Tennessee woman seeks to turn dreams into reality on her third trip to American Idol
stories.summary: Carie Ferra, also known as the singing waitress, has now auditioned for American Idol three times. She's hoping her third time's the charm.

stories.title: Pigeon Forge's 'Country Tonite Theatre' to close after 30 seasons; owner cites leadership changes
stories.summary: In an announcement on Saturday, leaders said they decided to conclude operations at the end of the year rather than transition to new management.

stories.title: DA: Blount County man sentenced to over a decade in prison for 2025 crash that killed 31-year-old
stories.summary: Ronald Morgan Weaver Jr. was sentenced to 11.5 years on Nov. 20 for vehicular homicide and driving while impaired, the DA said.

stories.title: Greene County fire 100% contained at 1,875 acres, officials say
stories.summary: The Tennessee Department of Forestry provided an update Sunday morning, four days after the fire started.

stories.title: Vols beat LSU 27-13, keep playoff dreams alive
stories.summary: Tennessee had a strong second half, including a 55-yard touchdown run from Faizon Brandon, to defeat Lane Kiffin and LSU.

stories.title: More than a tailgate: Tennessee family worries 40-year game day tradition could come to an end
stories.summary: Three generations of a Tennessee family have spent game days at Tyson House for over 40 years. Now, they're unsure if they'll be back next season.

stories.title: KFD: Man arrested in Ohio, charged in connection with Nov. 5 Cedar Bluff apartment fire
stories.summary: The Knoxville Fire Department said 39-year-old Joseph Farler is charged with aggravated arson.

stories.title: Campers and vehicles destroyed after fire breaks out at Beach Island Marina in Maynardville
stories.summary: Officials told 10News that only one of the campers that burned was being used as a full-time residence.

stories.title: Knoxville parents and students react to new school zone speeding cameras
stories.summary: In Knoxville, new speeding cameras near schools spark mixed reactions. While some stress improved safety, others worry about potential inaccuracies.

stories.title: Inmates in Loudon County complete tool certification to build a new future
stories.summary: Ten inmates at Loudon County Jail have gained certification in hand tool skills through the Tennessee College of Applied Technology's program.

stories.title: How a Gatlinburg homeowner turned into a 'garden hose firefighter'
stories.summary: During the historic 2016 wildfires, Steve Ogle spent an entire night protecting his homestead from flames using nothing but garden hoses.
